about_meta_title: About Wildcat Muay Thai — family-led gym in Chiang Mai
about_meta_desc: Wildcat Muay Thai is a family-led, woman-run gym in Hang Dong, Chiang Mai. Open-air training, real Thai coaches and a community from around the world.
about_hero_title: Run by a woman, built like a
about_hero_lead: Wildcat was born in Chiang Mai from a simple idea: real Muay Thai, taught with warmth. No ego at the door — just real training and real people.
about_story_title: Come for the fight, stay for the
about_story_p1: We're an open-air gym in a Hang Dong garden — ring, bags, pool and shade. Training here means golden-hour sessions, post-class meals and people who learn your name on day one.
about_story_p2: Whether you come for a single class or a whole season, you join a small community of locals, travellers and long-stayers who train together and grow together.
dtv_meta_title: DTV Visa Chiang Mai — train Muay Thai, stay up to 5 years
dtv_meta_desc: Get your Thailand DTV visa through Muay Thai training at Wildcat Chiang Mai. Enrolment letter & training confirmation provided — stay up to 5 years.
dtv_hero_lead: The Destination Thailand Visa lets you live in Chiang Mai with Muay Thai training as your qualifying activity — up to 5 years, 180 days per entry. We provide the training documents that support your application.
dtv_intro_p1: The Destination Thailand Visa (DTV) is Thailand's 5-year, multiple-entry visa for remote workers and people joining Thai soft-power activities — including Muay Thai training. Each entry lets you stay up to 180 days, extendable once.
dtv_intro_p2: Training at a recognised gym counts as a qualifying activity. That's where we come in: enrol in a long-term program at Wildcat and we provide the paperwork your application needs.
dtv_step1_b: Pick a monthly or multi-month training plan at Wildcat — your qualifying soft-power activity.
dtv_step2_b: We provide your enrolment letter and training confirmation, ready for your application.
dtv_step3_b: Apply at a Thai embassy or via e-visa, then make Chiang Mai home — up to 5 years.
dtv_inc1_b: Official confirmation of your long-term enrolment, issued by the gym.
dtv_inc2_b: Proof of ongoing training for extensions and re-entries.
dtv_inc3_b: Stay mobile during your season — rental available on site.
dtv_inc4_b: Accommodation pointers, local tips and a community from day one.
dtv_elig_body: Most applicants need a passport, proof of funds (around 500,000 THB) and a qualifying activity — that's your Muay Thai enrolment. Requirements vary by embassy; message us and we'll point you in the right direction for your situation.
dtv_faq_q1: How long can I stay on a DTV?
dtv_faq_a1: The visa is valid 5 years, multiple entry. Each entry allows up to 180 days, extendable once for another 180 days inside Thailand.
dtv_faq_q2: Does Muay Thai training really qualify?
dtv_faq_a2: Yes — Muay Thai is one of Thailand's recognised soft-power activities. A long-term enrolment at a gym like Wildcat is your qualifying activity.
dtv_faq_a3: An enrolment letter and a training confirmation matching your program. The rest (passport, proof of funds, application) stays on your side — we'll guide you through it.
dtv_faq_q4: How much money do I need to show?
dtv_faq_a4: Embassies generally ask for proof of around 500,000 THB in savings. Exact requirements vary by embassy — check the one where you'll apply.
dtv_faq_a5: At a Thai embassy or consulate outside Thailand, or online via the official Thai e-visa system, depending on your country.

faq_q1: Do I need experience to start?
faq_a1: Not at all. Most of our members started as complete beginners. Our coaches meet you exactly where you are — come as you are.
faq_a2: Just comfortable clothes, water and a towel. We have gloves and wraps you can borrow for your first sessions.
faq_q3: Can I try a class before joining?
faq_a3: Yes — drop in for a single class any day, or ask us about a free first-timer session. No commitment needed.
faq_q4: How does the DTV visa work?
faq_a4: Enrol in a long-term training program and we'll provide an enrolment letter and training confirmation to support your DTV application — letting you stay in Thailand up to 5 years.
faq_a5: Yes, we offer scooter rental on site so you can stay mobile during your training season — no separate shop needed.
